candidates.description: This vector represents Thai language script characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens.
This vector activates on common Thai words and prefixes, particularly centered around forms of the verb "to be" (เป็น) and surrounding contextual characters.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters and text fragments.
This feature activates on multilingual text segments containing the letters "pr" or their phonetic equivalents.
This vector activates on diverse fragments of non-English scripts, particularly Thai characters and specific punctuation marks.
This feature vector activates on atmospheric weather elements, specifically relating to clouds and sky conditions.
This vector activates on prefixes and roots related to transparency, light, and atmospheric layers, alongside unrelated noisy subwords from various scripts.
This feature vector represents multilingual subwords and character fragments containing the letters 'l' and 'r'.
Subword fragments of unrelated words and multilingual characters acting as noise or garbage tokens.
These tokens represent multilingual subwords and character n-grams spanning several different writing systems.
